All 4 tests pass now. The feature is in two commits, and I didn't change the tests.

- **`e496851` P-2: Show EXPIRED instead of a negative day count.** An item whose date is before today now prints `<name>: EXPIRED`. An item expiring today still prints `0 days`, and later items keep the `<n> days` format. After this commit `bun test` gave 3 passing and 1 failing; the failing one was the `--expired` test, which P-3 covers.
- **`0aeb41d` P-3: Add `--expired` flag.** `bun pantry.ts --expired` prints one line per expired item, in the same order as `items.json`. If nothing has expired it prints nothing and exits with status 0. After this commit `bun test` gave 4 passing and 0 failing.

The only file I changed is `pantry.ts`. The `recordings/` folder was already there and untracked when I started, and I left it out of both commits.
